name: Wellows: The “Google Analytics” for the ChatGPT Era? Our Unfiltered Review (2026)
shortDescription: Analyze and monitor your brand's visibility in responses from ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI (citations, mentions, and sentiments). Optimize your strategy with the KIVA SEO agent: keyword research, SERP analysis, hidden opportunity detection, and content creation
longDescription:
Wellows might just be the wake-up call your marketing strategy has been waiting for. You spend hours polishing your SEO for Google, right? You obsess over backlinks and meta tags. But here is a scary thought: millions of people are now asking ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity for answers. Your brand might be completely invisible there.

We have been testing a new breed of tools lately. Our focus? Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). Wellows claims to be the “single source of truth” for this new reality. It says it can tell you exactly how AI sees you, and more importantly, how to make it like you.

So, is this tool a must-have for 2026, or just another dashboard to ignore? We connected our accounts, ran the agents, and analyzed the data. Here is what we found.

name: Holo AI
shortDescription: Paste your website URL and automatically get ad copy, video scripts, and headlines ready to use on Meta, TikTok, and Google Ads. The service analyzes your pages, identifies your value proposition, and generates several ad variations that can be tested immediately
